Package gui

Class AddReservation_GUI

java.lang.Object
gui.AddReservation_GUI
public class AddReservation_GUI extends Object
Controller for the New Reservation screen. Handles dynamic time slot generation, date restrictions, guest capacity management, and dark mode UI components. This class ensures that users can only pick valid operating hours.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the UI components. Sets up the date range restrictions, initializes the guest spinner, and requests current restaurant data (tables and hours) from the server.

    • updateSpinnerLimit

      public void updateSpinnerLimit(int realMaxCapacity)
      Updates the maximum capacity allowed in the guests spinner. Called by Client_Controller once table data is received from the DB.
      Parameters:
      realMaxCapacity - The actual maximum table size found in the restaurant.

    • loadDynamicHours

      public void loadDynamicHours(LocalDate selectedDate)
      Dynamically generates time slots for the ComboBox based on restaurant hours. Accounts for: 1. Date-specific exceptions (Holidays/Events). 2. Regular weekly schedules. 3. Same-day buffer (1 hour ahead + 30 min rounding). 4. Midnight crossing shifts (e.g., 20:00 to 02:00).
      Parameters:
      selectedDate - The date chosen by the user.

    • showSuccessAlert

      public void showSuccessAlert(int code)
      Displays the unique reservation code upon successful booking

    • showNoTableAlert

      public void showNoTableAlert(LocalDateTime suggested)
      Triggered when the requested time is full. Offers the user an alternative time slot.
      Parameters:
      suggested - The nearest available LocalDateTime suggested by the server.
